hypothesis: With chi identified as ordinary matter (author decision 2026-11-10), the UET portal produces a composition-independent Yukawa force alpha = g_c^2/(2 kappa m_chi^4), lambda = 1/m_psi (claim C_PORTAL_FIFTH_FORCE). Published inverse-square-law and lunar-laser-ranging bounds then limit the portal coupling g_c as a function of m_psi.

observable.quantity: upper bound g_c_max on the canonical portal coupling at the registered ranges, and the corresponding m_psi
observable.domain: torsion balance: all lambda >= 38.6 um (m_psi <= 5.1e-3 eV); lunar laser ranging: lambda = a/2 = 1.922e8 m only

prediction_method.description: g_c_max = m_chi^2 sqrt(2 kappa alpha_max) for each registered bound (alpha_max, lambda); m_psi = hbar c / lambda; m_chi = mean nucleon mass 0.9389e9 eV; kappa = 1/(2.435e27 eV)^2; Earth-Moon distance a = 3.844e8 m; no refit of the published bounds

fixed_parameters: alpha = g_c^2/(2 kappa m_chi^4), lambda = 1/m_psi, from claim C_PORTAL_FIFTH_FORCE
chi = ordinary matter, single species with m_chi = mean nucleon mass
published bounds exactly as registered under T005_YUKAWA_BOUNDS; the lunar bound is used only at its registered range
pass_criterion: PASS if, at each registered bound, the set of admissible g_c (|g_c| < g_c_max) is non-empty. The Result must report g_c_max and m_psi for each bound as numbers, and the same bound in the parent form h sqrt(eps/k)/Z.
fail_criterion: Because g_c is free and g_c = 0 is admissible, FAILED is not reachable unless the author fixes a lower bound g_c >= g_min before approval; in that case FAILED if g_min > g_c_max at any registered bound where m_psi applies. INCONCLUSIVE if the registered values disagree with the journal texts, or if the chi = ordinary matter decision is withdrawn.
note: Disclosure: drafted after reading both source statements, and the conversion is simple enough that the outcome is effectively known: about g_c < 5e-10 eV for m_psi <= 5e-3 eV, and about g_c < 4e-15 eV at m_psi near 1e-15 eV. The script was not run. Consequence for author point 2: unless psi is heavier than about 5e-3 eV, the portal exchange channel is limited to below gravitational strength. Only two anchor points of the exclusion curves are used; planetary and other ranges are not tested. With g_c not small, neutron stars would carry extra scalar charge and T001 (which assumed alpha0 = 0) would need revisiting. Approved by the author on 2026-11-10 as drafted (no g_min, CONSTRAINT only), without a journal cross-check.
